entry.title: Azure/azure-sdk-for-net - Releases - 2026-11-20
entry.content:
Azure.Storage.Blobs.Batch_12.27.2

12.27.2 (2026-11-19)

Other Changes

  • Upgraded Azure.Storage.Blobs package dependency to 12.30.2

Azure.Storage.Files.Shares_12.28.1

12.28.1 (2026-11-19)

Bugs Fixed

  • Fixed SAS timestamp handling for non-UTC DateTimeOffset values. SAS times are now normalized to UTC before formatting/signing, preventing unintended validity windows in st/se (Start Time, Expiry Time) and related delegation key fields. Affected APIs include:
    • ShareClient.GenerateSasUri(...)
    • ShareClient.GenerateUserDelegationSasUri(...)
    • ShareDirectoryClient.GenerateSasUri(...)
    • ShareFileClient.GenerateSasUri(...)
    • ShareFileClient.GenerateUserDelegationSasUri(...)
    • ShareServiceClient.GenerateAccountSasUri(...)
    • ShareSasBuilder
  • Fixed SAS builder/client share and path name validation to use ordinal comparisons in ShareClient, ShareDirectoryClient, and ShareFileClient, so culture-equivalent but service-distinct Unicode names are rejected when generating SAS URIs.
  • Fixed an issue where conditional create/write flows using structured-message upload validation could classify 409 *AlreadyExists responses as non-errors, potentially resulting in InvalidDataException instead of the expected RequestFailedException.

Azure.Storage.Blobs_12.30.2

12.30.2 (2026-11-19)

Bugs Fixed

  • Fixed SAS builder/client resource-name validation to use ordinal comparisons in BlobBaseClient and BlobContainerClient, so culture-equivalent but service-distinct Unicode names are rejected when generating SAS URIs.
  • Fixed an issue where BlobClient.Upload(..., overwrite: false) with upload checksum validation configured as StorageChecksumAlgorithm.StorageCrc64 could throw InvalidDataException when the blob already existed. The operation now surfaces the expected RequestFailedException for 409 *AlreadyExists.
  • Fixed client-side encryption v1 decryption of ranged downloads so the 16-byte IV is fully read even when the ciphertext stream returns short reads, and a truncated IV now fails instead of silently corrupting plaintext.
  • Fixed SAS timestamp handling for non-UTC DateTimeOffset values. SAS times are now normalized to UTC before formatting/signing, preventing unintended validity windows in st/se (Start Time, Expiry Time) and related delegation key fields. Affected APIs include:
    • BlobBaseClient.GenerateSasUri(...)
    • BlobBaseClient.GenerateUserDelegationSasUri(...)
    • BlobContainerClient.GenerateSasUri(...)
    • BlobContainerClient.GenerateUserDelegationSasUri(...)
    • BlobServiceClient.GenerateAccountSasUri(...)
    • BlobSasBuilder

Azure.Storage.Queues_12.28.2

12.28.2 (2026-11-19)

Bugs Fixed

  • Fixed SAS timestamp handling for non-UTC DateTimeOffset values. SAS times are now normalized to UTC before formatting/signing, preventing unintended validity windows in st/se (Start Time, Expiry Time) and related delegation key fields. Affected APIs include:
    • QueueClient.GenerateSasUri(...)
    • QueueClient.GenerateUserDelegationSasUri(...)
    • QueueServiceClient.GenerateAccountSasUri(...)
    • QueueSasBuilder
  • Fixed SAS builder/client queue-name validation to use ordinal comparisons in QueueClient, so culture-equivalent but service-distinct Unicode names are rejected when generating SAS URIs.

Azure.Storage.Common_12.29.1

12.29.1 (2026-11-19)

Bugs Fixed

  • Fixed SAS timestamp handling for non-UTC DateTimeOffset values (e.g. AccountSasBuilder). Times are now converted to UTC before formatting/signing to prevent unintended validity windows in st/se and related delegation key time fields.
  • Fixed an issue where conditional 409 *AlreadyExists responses on structured-message requests were incorrectly classified as non-errors, which could cause InvalidDataException to be thrown instead of the expected RequestFailedException.
